QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_45

question.text: Which category of AIF pays tax at the FUND level (pass-through not available for business income), impacting distributions to investors?

answer.text: No AIF pays tax at fund level

explanation.text: The Logic: Category III AIF income is, in practice, taxed and discharged at the fund level (including portfolio income streams), which directly reduces amounts available for distribution to investors. This contrasts with the Category I/II treatment. The Trap: Categories I and II enjoy pass-through status under Section 115UB for income other than business income; business income still remains taxable at the fund level even for Cat I/II. Option D is incorrect because at least Category III AIFs are taxed at the fund level. Note: The pass-through benefit for Cat I/II excludes business income. The fund-level tax burden on Cat III makes its post-tax returns notably different from pre-tax returns.
